title: Gap Fill by Weekday
summary: The gap-fill rate split by weekday. Each row's denominator is the gapped sessions (roll days excluded by construction) whose trade date fell on that weekday; the numerator is the ones that traded back to the prior session's close. Weekday buckets divide an already-conditional sample, so read every row's N and interval against the all-days rate before believing a day is special.

params.name: minGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at least this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

deltas: one grouped result instead of five separate weekday reports
per-weekday N and 95% CI expose which day-of-week differences are noise
direction and size filters stack on top of the weekday split
unlimited history — your data decides the depth
